description: Get VPS metrics for a timeframe. Each point is a Proxmox RRD average: `netInBytes`, `netOutBytes`, `diskReadBytes` and `diskWriteBytes` are average bytes per second over the point's step (not byte volumes; multiply by the gap between consecutive `time` values to get a volume), `cpuPercent` is the CPU usage in percent and `memoryUsedMb`/`memoryMaxMb` are MiB. `time` is a Unix timestamp in seconds. `points` is empty only when the VPS is not running. If the host of a running VPS does not return monitoring data (ZapX retries once), the call fails with HTTP 503 `vserver_metrics_unavailable` (MCP: an error result saying the metrics are temporarily unavailable) instead of returning an empty list: that does not mean the VPS is idle, retry later.

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: get_vserver_metrics
title: Get VPS Metrics
